span.p:
Robot.step(env, t), every tick
drain battery, then by state:
MOVING / DELIVERING: up to 1 cell
PICKING / UNLOADING: one tick
BLOCKED: next cell occupied
WAITING: held, or asked and not answered
CHARGING: +1.2 % per tick
IDLE: nothing to do
